title: Chapter 207 Incomplete Report (Vi)
content:
Chapter 207 Incomplete Report (Vi)

Shi Lisha was stunned immediately and stood there in a daze.

And the Sakura Guzi that Ayub was dealing with was very good at ninjutsu. With her agility as the main skill, she repeatedly dodged Ayub's powerful attacks, and she seemed to be quite capable, and occasionally she could even fight back with a knife.

Like Wang Shuo, Ayub mainly added strength and physique, and his agility was not low.

But he was still not as good as this kind of warrior who mainly added agility.

But as long as Ayub seized the opportunity, Sakura Guzi would have no chance.

"Swoosh, swoosh..."

The sound of five black iron spears breaking through the air sounded.

The two people under control were directly pierced by the spears, and like Dr. Jia before, they were hung on the wall.

And Sakura Guzi dodged this attack sharply, which made Wang Shuo look at her with new eyes.

"Put down the things you just picked up, and I can spare your life."

Wang Shuo looked at Sakura Guzi coldly, his eyes narrowed slightly, and a hint of fierceness appeared in his eyes.

Yinghua Guzi didn't care and smiled at Wang Shuo: "Do you think you can catch me?"

As she spoke, her figure gradually faded and disappeared strangely.

Wang Shuo was slightly startled. A living person just disappeared like this. What kind of strange trick was it?

In desperation, Wang Shuo could only tell his subordinates to guard the exit first.

In case the other party was still at the scene, there was still a chance to recover the spoils she picked up.

"Abu, can you see clearly what she picked up?"

"My Lord, a sword and a soft armor."

Wang Shuo turned around without comment and asked people to tie up Locke and Shi Lisha who were nailed to the wall.

He walked slowly to Ye Xueer's side and handed her a bottle of life potion. His expression slowed down and said: "What do these two people have to do with you?"

Ye Xueer hesitated for a moment, but still took the life potion handed to her by Wang Shuo, but did not take it.

He shook his head gently and whispered, "It's nothing. We just met in the dungeon."

Wang Shuo breathed a sigh of relief, walked to Locke and the other man, and said sternly, "You two, hand over your things!"

"Hmph, forget it." Locke spat out a mouthful of blood and tilted his head to look to the side.

And Shi Lisha was silent.

Gong Zheng and Ayub handed the spoils they picked up to Wang Shuo.

Among them was the fragments of the report, which made Wang Shuo breathe a sigh of relief.

[Battery blueprint +1, Dead Spirit Orb production blueprint +1, Intermediate Arrow Tower construction blueprint +1]

[Obtained the incomplete report (six), the side quest completion progress 55%. ]

The animation unfolded in front of Wang Shuo.

The cities near Black Dragon City continued to fall, and in the military camp, some soldiers began to be invaded by the dead air, and some soldiers even turned into undead without going through the transformation of the altar.

This change shocked the top leaders of Black Dragon City.

Afterwards, some of the captured undead skeletons and strange beasts were sent to the research institute.

Dr. Jia personally led a group of researchers to start continuous research.

They dissected corpses, analyzed the skeletons of the undead with various instruments, and even used humans for experiments.

After half a month of research, there was still no improvement!

Dr. Jia's handsome face aged rapidly in the day and night research.

After countless repeated experiments, Dr. Jia finally discovered a formation similar to the spirit gathering formation that can gather dead air. They called this improved formation "gathering dead spirit formation".

This discovery shocked everyone. After countless attempts, they found that the gathering dead spirit formation could be engraved on a special kind of dark wood to make a "dead spirit bead".

Soldiers wearing it can use this bead to absorb the dead air on their bodies, so as to avoid being invaded by the dead air and being transformed into undead.

When the Black Dragon King learned that Dr. Jia had researched the dead spirit bead, he was overjoyed and immediately ordered people to manufacture it in large quantities.

The military workshop produced the dead spirit beads day and night to equip the soldiers of Black Dragon City.

Although the dead spirit beads had initially eased the war, the army of Black Dragon City was still losing ground.

The two sides fought a decisive battle on an ancient battlefield - the ancient battlefield!

In this battle, the Black Dragon City army was defeated!

The important reason for the defeat was that this kind of dead spirit bead had a huge disadvantage, that is, it could not absorb the dead air infinitely.

When the internal space capacity was full, it could no longer absorb.

After a period of research at the research institute, Dr. Jia discovered that the water of life could purify the dead air.

But outside Black Dragon City, there were already overwhelming undead spirits, and Black Dragon City was powerless to save the situation!
